verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API at api.otter.ai/v1 with API-key auth. The API is described only as providing programmatic access to *retrieve* channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines and workspace details, and it is limited to Enterprise workspaces. The pricing page also lists API & Webhooks, and the MCP server offers further read access. Nothing shows the API can perform UI actions such as scheduling the notetaker, uploading files, editing notes, sharing, or running AI Chat, so UI parity is far from demonstrated. Missing for 10: write/action endpoints matching UI capabilities (upload, record/schedule, edit, share, chat), a machine-readable spec or full reference, availability beyond Enterprise, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Otter's Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details
